title: 1.5 Measuring and Constructing Angles

icans: I can name, measure, and classify angles.
I can use the Angle Addition Postulate to find angle measures.
I can use an angle bisector to find angle measures.

vocab: a figure formed by two rays with the same ___________, called the vertex
a ray that divides an angle into two ____________ angles

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Naming angles: ∠ABC, ∠CBA, and ∠B can name the same angle; the vertex _______________ is the middle letter.

blocks.stem: Name the angle in three ways. Then classify it.

notes: Angle Addition Postulate: if P is in the interior of ∠RST, then m∠RSP + m∠PST = _______________.

blocks.stem: m∠RST = 75°. Find x, m∠RSP, and m∠PST.

notes: Angle bisector: it divides an angle into two _______________ angles, so each half is half the whole.

blocks.stem: Ray YW bisects ∠XYZ. m∠XYW = (4x − 3)° and m∠WYZ = (2x + 11)°. Find x and m∠XYZ.
A ray bisects an angle into ∠1 and ∠2. m∠1 = (5x − 4)° and m∠2 = (3x + 12)°. Find x and the measure of the whole angle.

tickets.stem: P is in the interior of ∠RST. m∠RSP = 28° and m∠PST = 47°. Find m∠RST.
